decisive_items: mass arising from the bone and extending into the soft tissues
cortical bone lysis with medullary involvement
response.rationale: Age 9, aggressive bone lesion with soft-tissue extension and enhancement favors Ewing's sarcoma over osteosarcoma; osteomyelitis lacks systemic symptoms and osteochondroma lacks lysis.

rejected.why: Benign osteochondroma contradicts cortical lysis and medullary involvement.
No systemic symptoms or trauma argues against osteomyelitis.
